institution_count.note: Sourced from IHEP's (JUNO's host institute) official English-language press release, not a page on JUNO's own collaboration domain that itself states an institution count; JUNO's own homepage (juno.ihep.cas.cn) references a '25th International Collaboration Meeting' but does not itself state scientist/institution/country counts in the page fetched this session.

country_count.note: Same source-tier caveat as institution_count above.

member_count.note: Reported as 'more than 700'; recorded as 700 (a floor, not an exact count). Same source-tier caveat as institution_count above.

notes: The brief for this workstream specified using membership counts 'only from the collaboration's own page'; the counts recorded here come from IHEP's official press release (IHEP is JUNO's host institute and lead publisher) rather than a dedicated members/institutions page on juno.ihep.cas.cn, because no such page was found in the pages fetched this session. This is noted explicitly per-field above rather than silently treated as the collaboration's own primary listing.
Institution-level membership rows and leadership/person records are owned by other workstreams (membership-lead) and are not written here.

summary.plain: The international team of more than 700 scientists from 75 institutions in 17 countries and regions who built and run the JUNO neutrino experiment.
summary.technical: International collaboration operating the JUNO reactor-antineutrino oscillation experiment; per IHEP's November 2025 announcement, more than 700 scientists from 75 institutions in 17 countries and regions.
